message: 僕らの学園は戦場だった
Faced with our fierce assault, the demons lost the will to fight and scattered in retreat.

name: Shio
message: 「If you've learned your lesson, never again think of standing in the way of my Kogitsunemaru!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, I'm leaving you behind.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, please wait!! Big Sister!!」
Paying no mind to the fleeing enemies, we charged at full speed toward Finis Tower.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Old man! Huh, yes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President! He says there are demons up ahead.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about the side paths?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems there are some over there too!」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Nyaaa!」
Demons blocking our path once again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here they come!」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't really have time to deal with you right now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They seem to have plenty of free time, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「We'll just scatter them!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go!」
Our momentum couldn't be stopped.
In less than a minute, the demons were routed.
Still, we couldn't afford to linger.
From behind and from both sides, the presence of demons closed in.
Though our swift movements had broken through their encirclement, they had already regrouped.

name: Synn
message: 「Hurry!」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't have to tell me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where on earth are they?!」
It should be right here, yet I also feel a massive presence close by.
And right in front of us, at that.
Even though the presence is even larger than Eauderourke's, there's no demon in sight.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-nya-nya! You've shown up, nya, you peasants!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why is Prier's delinquent waitress here?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though Big Sis was supposed to have evacuated everyone」

name: Paqy
message: 「Before that, today is Sunday, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter how problematic a waitress she is, we can't get her caught up in this」

name: Pasta
message: 「Calling me a delinquent and problematic--you guys are so rude, nya!」

name: Ria
message: 「She must have gotten the date wrong and come to school」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a clumsy person. She really is a delinquent and a airhead」

name: Synn
message: 「It's dangerous here, so please hide somewhere. I'm begging you」
The presence of the demons is steadily closing in.
The massive presence hasn't disappeared either.

name: Pasta
message: 「U―Um, nya. Pasta is―」

name: Misa
message: 「Where could the ringleader be hiding, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Waitress. Please don't worry. We will definitely protect you」

name: Pasta
message: 「Could it be... you're worried about Pasta, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because we are the Ryuusei Student Council, who protect the community and the academy!」

name: Pasta
message: 「*sniffle*...」

name: Pasta
message: 「You guys are good people, nya! I'm a little touched, nya」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-This is bad! Apparently, this place is completely surrounded!」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya and the Chairwoman say they're going to make a forced landing!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, don't!」
No matter how terrifying a person Riesling-san is, and no matter how eccentric Helena-san is, they are sadly just ordinary humans. They can't rescue us while defending a helicopter from demons.

name: Pasta
message: 「Fufufu. Now you can't escape, nya, Student Council!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way!? Miss Waitress was the boss!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it, the biggest presence is right in front of us! That caught me completely off guard!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A bigger surprise than 'Those Wavering in Love'!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's right, nya! I'm Pasta, Number 2 of the Demon World's Seven Demon Generals, nya!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why the heck is someone like that working as a waitress?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Perhaps she is short on money because she is a demon?」

name: Ria
message: 「Pasta-chan, if you do something like this, you'll get fired from Prier.」

name: Pasta
message: 「It'll be fine, nya. Your mouths will be silent starting tomorrow, nya! I'll still get my rakugan and my part-time pay, nya!」
Over 40 demons surrounding the plaza.
On top of that, a Demon General even stronger than any demon they had faced so far.
A desperate situation!

name: Pasta
message: 「However, you guys worried about Pasta, nya. I was a little moved, nya. So I won't let the guys around us lay a hand on you, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta and her royal guard will take you on, nya!」
Several more demons appeared from behind Pasta.
Indeed, their magical presence was thicker than the other small fry.

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Nya!」
Skip the battle?
